items.q: Do you really visit my home for free?
items.a: Yes — anywhere in Pune. Our consultant brings fabric swatches, foam samples and shade cards to your home or office. There is no fee and no obligation to buy.

items.q: How long does a custom sofa take?
items.a: Standard custom sofas are delivered in 12–18 working days. Larger or fully bespoke pieces take 18–25 days. We give you a date in writing and stick to it.

items.q: Can you repair my old sofa or curtains?
items.a: Absolutely — restoration is our speciality. We do re-upholstery, refoaming, frame repair, polishing, curtain re-stitching and blind servicing. Pickup and drop is available across Pune.

Sofa frames carry a lifetime warranty. Foam, springs, mechanisms and stitching are covered for up to 10 years. Mattresses come with a 10-year warranty and wooden furniture with a 5-year structural warranty.

items.q: Do you take bulk orders for hotels, offices or builders?
items.a: Yes. Orders from 25 to 5,000+ units, with custom branding, GST invoicing and project-level credit terms. Choose “B2B / Bulk” in the quote form and our projects team will call you.

items.q: How do I pay? Is EMI available?
items.a: UPI, bank transfer, cash and all major cards. EMI is available on most credit and debit cards for 3, 6, 9 and 12 months. B2B orders can be set up with 30 or 60-day credit terms.

items.q: Which areas of Pune do you cover?
items.a: We serve all of Pune and PCMC — including Tingre Nagar, Dhanori, Viman Nagar, Kharadi, Wagholi, Lohegaon, Vishrantwadi, Kalyani Nagar, Koregaon Park, Aundh, Baner, Hadapsar and Pimpri-Chinchwad. Ask us about nearby areas too.
